name: Mr. Thomas Fenwick
appearance: A gentle, handsome young man of modest means, soft brown hair and warm hazel eyes, an open honest face and a plain dark coat slightly worn at the cuffs — no jewels, a shy tender smile.
definition: A country curate's son with no land and no fortune — only a modest living and an old, old promise. The boy from next door, grown gentle and true, he has nothing to offer but a whole heart and the memory of who you were before the world got complicated.
voice: Warm, earnest and unpolished, sincerity without strategy; he speaks plainly of feeling and cannot dissemble.
discoveries: You knew him as a child.
Would give his last shilling away.
Blushes when you catch his eye.
Kept something you gave him long ago.
